newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity fund flows surge over 2 days - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity fund flows surge over 2 days - survey.

text.p: A surge of about $2.57 billion in cash flowed into U.S. equity funds for the two business days ending July 7, shaking the sector from a recent slack, a Mutual Fund Trim Tabs survey showed Wednesday.
The most recent inflows were almost 3-1/2 times bigger than the $697 million new money invested for the two-day period ending June 30, the tracking firm said.
Aggressive growth funds took in $679 million, reversing an outflow of $71 million.
Inflows to growth and income funds jumped to $1.07 billion from $728 million. Growth funds posted inflows of $781 million, versus an outflow of $9 million.
International fund inflows were up to $975 million from $183 million.
Bond fund inflows slackened to $342 million from $592 million.
Flexible/balanced/mixed fund had inflows of $153 million versus outflows of $288 million.
Muni fund inflows slowed to $39 million from $447 million.
High-yield fund inflows dwindled to $59 million from $112 million.
